criteria.criterion: AC1: session_runner.py accepts --ablate-rule <rule.mdc> argument; --help output contains 'ablate-rule'
criteria.evidence: python tests/eval/session_runner.py --help | grep ablate-rule matched '--ablate-rule RULE.MDC' in usage and option help (session_runner.py lines 500-509).

criteria.criterion: AC2: Four JSON files per scenario under run_dir/ablation/<rule_stem>/sessions/{control,ablated}/ and judgments/{control,ablated}/
criteria.evidence: _save_ablation_session (lines 347-354) writes run_dir/ablation/<rule_stem>/sessions/<arm>/<scenario_id>.json; _save_ablation_judgment (lines 357-364) writes judgments/<arm>/<scenario_id>.json; _run_ablation calls both for control and ablated arms (lines 394-405).
